paite: Upa in, deihtak Gaias thutak a ka it kiang ah;
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: deihtak, na kha in vualzawlna amuh bang in, bangkim a vualzawlna na muh leh na damtheihna ding in ka thum zel hi.
Unaute ahong pai un, thutak a na hindan leh na muanhuaidan ahon theihpih ziak un ka kipak mahmah hi.
Ka tate thutak ah a-om uh chih ka zak kan a kipahna thupizaw ka nei kei hi.
Deihtak unaute mikhual himah le uh, atung ua na hih peuh ah muanhuaitak in na hih zel a;
heading: Gaias Thilphalna

paite: huaite'n saptuamte ma ah na itna atheipihta uhi; amau tuh azinna ua Pathian mite hihtuak him a na khakkhiakleh na hihhoih ding hi.
Amau Khrist min a azinna uah Zentelte kiang a kipan bangmah la lou in apawt zel ngal ua.
Huchi in thutak a seppihte i hihtheihna ding in huchibang mite, eite'n i kipahpih ding mah ahi.
Saptuamte kiang ah thu neukha zaw ka gelhta; himahleh Diotrephes, alak ua tungnun ut nakpa'n akipahpih kei hi.
heading: Diotrephes

paite: Huaiziak in ka hong paileh athilhihte ka pholhkhe ding a, i tung ua thu dikloupi agen a akamtamdan ka theikhesak ding hi. Huan huai leng hun asa kei a, amah ngei in unaute akipahpih kei a, akipahpih nuamte leng khou in saptuamte lak a kipan adelhkhia hi.
Deihtak, giloumi omdan zui ke'n, ahoih zui zaw in. Kuapeuh thil hoih hihmi tuh Pathian a pan ahi; thil gilou hihmi in Pathian amu ngei kei hi.
Demetrias in mi tengteng phat aloh a, thutak a phat nangawn aloh behlap hi; eite'n leng i phat ua, hiai phatna adik ahi chih na thei hi.
heading: Demetrias

paite: Na kiang ah thu tampi gelh ding ka nei, himahleh laitui leh laipuan a gelh ka ut kei hi.
heading: Mangpha Khakna

paite: Sawt lou nung chiang in hon muh ka lamen hi, huchi in kimaituah in i kihou ding.
Khamuanna na tung ah om hen. I lawmte'n chibai ahon buk uhi. Amin uh lou chiat in lawmte chibai hon buksak in.
